definitions.explanation: Indicates the highest degree or superlative.

examples.japanese: これが{最|もっと}も{大切|たいせつ}です。
{彼|かれ}は{最|もっと}も{優|すぐ}れた{選手|せんしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is the most excellent player.

examples.japanese: {最|もっと}も{人気|にんき}のある{映画|えいが}。

notes:
{最|もっと}も expresses the superlative degree.

USAGE:
- {最|もっと}も + adjective/verb: most ~
- More literary than 一番

COMPARISON:
- {一番|いちばん}: most (common, casual)
- {最|もっと}も: most (formal, written)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {最|もっと}も{重要|じゅうよう}: most important
- {最|もっと}も{良|よ}い: the best

Note: Don't confuse with もっと (more).
